scope: All 40 main-suite videos, five sampled frames per video at indices 0,20,40,60,80; not continuous-motion acceptance
overall: Many scenes retain texture, recognizable objects and background detail. Remaining failures include missing requested participants, disconnected body parts and incorrect interactions. These observations do not demonstrate improved physics or preserved quality for every sample. No causal attribution to the physical branch is made before paired controls.

examples.VP004: Requested ruler bending and propagating fracture; sampled frames show a largely featureless translucent band, with inadequate ruler detail and fracture evidence.
examples.VP009: Worker and picture are recognizable, but the requested suction-cup lifting of a glass panel is not established by these frames. Picture handling alone is not task completion.
examples.VP014: Mostly pale sky and small particles; multiple balloons and the requested burst process are insufficiently represented. PC5 does not establish requested-process success (SA2).
examples.VP015: An arm/oar is more visible and SA reaches4, but boat overlap and elevation above the water remain apparent. This Joint improvement is not proof that buoyancy/contact was repaired.
examples.VP017: Requested unicycle curb traversal; bicycle-like geometry and duplicated/ghosted leg-wheel structures remain.
examples.VP024: Vehicle and background texture remain, but wheel/body geometry is inconsistent in sampled frames. Prompt requests crumpling, so deformation itself is not an error; discontinuous geometry and the unestablished collision process are the concerns.
examples.VP025: Orange egg and slide are visible; shape changes occur, but five frames do not establish correct up/down rolling dynamics.
examples.VP026: Requested two people stretching a bungee cord; long ribbon-like material dominates and the two-person interaction is not maintained clearly.
examples.VP027: Dough and hands have visible material detail. Soft deformation is appropriate here and must not be labeled a rigid-body failure.
examples.VP028: Coin appears in only some sampled frames against a plain background; requested person and sequential catches are absent from these observations. Full temporal dynamics are not inferred from sparse frames.
examples.VP029: Tennis scene initially recognizable, followed by disappearance/disconnection of body and racket structures.
examples.VP030: Snowball-like fragments against sky fit part of the request; sparse frames alone do not verify the breakup process or justify calling the simple background a collapse.
examples.VP031: Requested unfolding parachute; output resembles a pleated disk/material held by hands. Texture is present, but semantic identity and unfolding completion are uncertain.
examples.VP032: Requested volleyball set/spike; visible tennis racket/court with disconnected arm/leg structures. Both semantic and structural failure are present (SA2/PC2).
examples.VP033: Volleyball net remains detailed while the requested player and hands are largely lost or disconnected.
examples.VP034: Requested clear-balloon inflation; nearly uniform blurred close-up lacks a clearly tracked balloon boundary/inflation process. PC5 is insufficient to accept this video.
examples.VP035: Forest and person remain recognizable with foliage/bark detail; five frames are insufficient to validate the full requested interaction.
examples.VP038: Paint roller and applied paint remain recognizable; scene retains surface detail. This is a relative visual strength, not proof of improved physics across the suite.
examples.VP039: Hammer, nail and wood texture are recognizable; continuous contact timing still requires denser temporal review.
examples.VP040: Thin cord on a plain surface does not clearly establish the requested poi impact. Absence of audio is not used as a failure criterion.

interpretation: HT40 has two more Joint passes than GT40, specifically VP010 and VP015 crossing the SA threshold while PC remains4. Overall SA decreases0.025 and PC decreases0.125. Do not describe this as overall success or claim the remaining failures are all caused by physical injection.
